debit.notes: 24x7 customer care (page states "Call us – 24*7 Customer Care"). To block: call 1800 1200 1200 / 1800 26 66677, select language, press 2 to block card; or AU 0101 app / AU 0101 NetBanking > Debit Card > 'Block this Card' > Permanent/Temporary > OTP (debit FAQ also lists Auro Chatbot as a block channel). No SMS block format is published for debit cards. Banking-services non-toll-free line: 1860 1200 1200 (contact page also lists toll-free 1800 313 313 under Banking Services). Overseas/NRI (non-toll-free, calling from overseas): +91 141-7141000, +91 141-6673220. Report unauthorised debit/ATM transactions: same IVR, press 1, or email customercare@aubank.in; the bank's page points online-fraud victims to cybercrime.gov.in. 1930 is not mentioned on the bank's pages.

credit.sms: Send SMS "TBLOCK<Space><Credit Card Last 4 digit><Space><Customer ID>" on 5676767 from registered mobile number to temporarily block; send SMS "PBLOCK<Space><Credit Card Last 4 digit><Space><Customer ID>" on 5676767 from registered mobile number to permanently block
credit.notes: 24x7 credit-card helpline 1800 1200 1500 (toll-free); non-toll-free 0141-7141100. Block via IVR: call 1800 1200 1500 and select the prompt "Report Lost or Stolen card" (report page: dial 2 for lost/stolen); AU 0101 app: Cards > Credit Card > 'Block/Unblock Credit Card'; AURO chatbot: Cards > Credit Card Services > 'Block and Reissue Lost/Stolen Card'; website credit-cards section 'Block Lost/Stolen Card'; AU 0101 NetBanking can block debit or credit cards immediately. SMS block from registered mobile number to 5676767: TBLOCK (temporary) or PBLOCK (permanent) with last 4 digits + Customer ID. Email creditcard.support@aubank.in; premium cards (Vetta, Zenith & Zenith+): creditcard.priority@aubank.in. Overseas/NRI (non-toll-free, calling from overseas): +91 141-7141000, +91 141-6673220. 1930 is not mentioned on the bank's pages.
